data.title: CJP to launch nationwide protest against Dharmendra Pradhan in Pune today, threatens indefinite Jantar Mantar sit-in
data.summary: The latest agitation comes days after the US-return Abhishek Dipke organised a protest at Jantar Mantar in Delhi on 6 June. The protest will be held at the Ambedkar Statue on the Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU) campus at 4 pm.

data.title: Farms to spike diesel, power demand for irrigation as monsoon may falter
data.summary: Sub-par monsoon rains could push up diesel consumption and electricity demand in India’s farm sector this kharif season as farmers rely more on groundwater irrigation. The shift may raise cultivation costs, spike fuel sales and add pressure on the already stretched power utilities

data.title: Man Accused of $37 Billion LA Fire Is Innocent, His Lawyer Says
data.summary: Jonathan Rinderknecht has been wrongly accused of starting the most destructive wildfire in Los Angeles history, his lawyer told a jury.

data.title: Centre pushes LPG users to switch to piped natural gas amid supply strain
data.summary: The petroleum ministry has asked states to accelerate migration to PNG where infrastructure exists as LPG under-recovery rises to ₹690 per cylinder and global supply pressures persist.

data.title: 339 report Shigellosis symptoms in Keralam's Wayanad, two test positive: What is the disease? How serious can it get?
data.summary: 339 people have reported shigellosis symptoms in Keralam, with two children testing positive. Hospitalizations include 21 at Sultan Bathery and 38 at private facilities. Health officials are inspecting food safety amid concerns of contamination, while monitoring for other diseases like Ebola.

data.title: Octavia E Butler’s powerful quote explains why habit is more dependable than inspiration
data.summary: Octavia E Butler's famous quote on habit and inspiration continues to inspire readers, offering a practical lesson on discipline, persistence and the power of consistent effort in work and daily life.
